<thought>From the 13C NMR data, the distinct chemical shift values are 139.25, 134.60, 129.00, 128.30, 49.40, 26.10, and 11.40 ppm. The repeated values (129.00 and 128.30) correspond to equivalent carbons. Thus there are 7 unique carbon environments.</thought>
<final_answer>7</final_answer>
